title: Marketing Systems Engineer
description:
About Us

We are a fast-growing lead generation and performance marketing company that builds technology-driven customer acquisition systems across multiple industries. Our business is powered by intelligent integrations, automation, AI, and scalable operational systems.

We're looking for a Marketing Systems Engineer to own and continuously improve the technology that powers our business.

 

About the Role

As our Marketing Systems Engineer, you'll be responsible for building, integrating, automating, and optimizing the systems that connect affiliates, advertising platforms, customers, call centers, buyers, CRMs, and internal operations.

 

You'll work directly with leadership to execute strategic initiatives, improve operational efficiency, and build scalable technology that supports our continued growth.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, implementing AI, and building reliable systems that make businesses run more efficiently.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Systems & Integrations

  • Build, manage, and optimize system integrations using APIs, webhooks, and automation tools.
  • Configure and maintain lead routing, call routing, CRM integrations, and operational workflows.
  • Implement and maintain conversion tracking, server-side events, attribution systems, and data flows across marketing platforms.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure reliable day-to-day operations.

  • Design scalable solutions that improve efficiency and eliminate manual processes.

     

Affiliate & Client Onboarding

  • Own the technical onboarding of new affiliates, partners, and clients.
  • Configure tracking, routing, landing pages, forms, and system integrations.
  • Perform end-to-end testing and quality assurance before launching new campaigns or partners.

 

AI & Automation

  • Design, build, and optimize AI-powered workflows and automations.
  • Develop and improve AI voice agents and conversational experiences.
  • Research, evaluate, and implement new AI technologies that improve business operations.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve efficiency across the organization.

 

Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner directly with leadership on strategic technology initiatives.
  • Coordinate with developers, vendors, and technology partners to successfully execute projects.
  • Own projects from planning through implementation.
  • Document systems, integrations, and technical processes to support long-term scalability.

 

What We're Looking For

 

You have experience with:

  • APIs, webhooks, and systems integration
  • Automation platforms and workflow design
  • JavaScript, Python, PHP, or similar programming languages
  • SQL and data manipulation
  • CRM and operational systems
  • Server-side tracking, conversion APIs, or attribution systems
  • AI tools, LLMs, automation platforms, or conversational AI (preferred)
  • Troubleshooting complex technical systems

 

Experience in lead generation, affiliate marketing, performance marketing, or call center technology is considered a strong asset.

 

Technologies You'll Work With

You'll work with a modern technology ecosystem that includes:

  • Affiliate and partner management systems
  • Lead and call routing platforms
  • CRM and customer data platforms
  • REST APIs and webhooks
  • Marketing automation and workflow orchestration
  • AI voice agents and conversational AI
  • Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI APIs
  • Landing page and form technologies
  • Telephony and contact center systems
  • Analytics, tracking, attribution, and conversion technologies
  • Cloud-based business applications and automation platforms

 

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you'll:

  • Successfully launch new affiliates, clients, and partners with minimal oversight.
  • Build reliable, scalable systems that support business growth.
  • Improve tracking accuracy and data integrity across our technology stack.
  • Increase operational efficiency through automation and AI.
  • Become the technical owner of the systems that power our business.

 

Who You Are

  • You take ownership and follow projects through to completion.
  • You enjoy solving problems and continuously improving how systems work.
  • You learn new technologies quickly and adapt to changing business needs.
  • You think in systems rather than isolated tasks.
  • You communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where your work has a direct impact on business growth.

If you're excited about building systems, implementing AI, and creating technology that helps scale a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.
